about: Which narrow database login may SELECT / INSERT / UPDATE / DELETE each public table or view (deploy/db-roles.md).
Every table must be listed, even with no grants (then say why in note). The owner login (sjcos: the website, Joe's own panel runs, migrations) owns everything and is not listed.

A change here needs the matching sjcos_grant(...) line in the same migration: node scripts/db-roles-sql.mjs <table> prints it. tests/db-roles-manifest-db.test.mjs compares this file with the database.
SELECT(a,b) = only those columns. sjcos_backup reads everything through pg_read_all_data (bootstrap), so only its writes are listed.

roles.sjcos_agent: MCP server (sjcos-mcp.service: Hermes, claude.ai, ChatGPT; stdio spawns), business-agent runs, staff panel turns. DATABASE_URL_AGENT.
roles.sjcos_worker: scripts/sjcos-worker.mjs: intent dispatch, Square / Telnyx / e-sign events, runbook wakeups. DATABASE_URL_WORKER.
roles.sjcos_backup: pg_dump + the backup_runs ledger in scripts/backup.mjs. DATABASE_URL_BACKUP.

invoker_trigger_functions.sjcos_guard_narrow_writes: must see the login that made the write; every other trigger function runs as its owner (SECURITY DEFINER, SET search_path = public, pg_temp)

app_settings.note: settings incl. pricing/markup and link tokens; agents read non-secret keys only (row security hides *.token)

chat_messages.note: Portal retry lineage and delivery state use existing website writes; no new login privileges.

push_devices.note: phone push tokens; push-drain runs inside the website (cron route)

qbo_connection.note: QuickBooks OAuth connection; QBO sync runs inside the website (cron route)

sms_messages.note: Retry lineage is supplied by website sends; no new login write path or privileges.

user_email_accounts.note: staff Gmail refresh tokens; only the website's own mailbox code reads them

users.note: logins and passwords: Joe's Settings › Team (website) or his own panel run only

inbox_preferences.note: Mailbox-scoped inbox screening and attention choices. Website only; no agent/worker write path.

inbox_drafts.note: Mailbox/user scoped synced drafts and AI suggestions, including exact source references. Website only; no agent/worker write path.
